title: Structuring Desk Standards: C&I Eligibility, Terms and Quote Timing
content:
Every Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts structure is sold only to a business customer, for a commercial premise, against a signed quote. The figures below are the entry thresholds, the terms that may be priced and the timing of the structuring desk.

## Entry thresholds

| Structure | Customer type | Premise class | Smallest 12-month historical usage | States offered | Signed quote required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | business | commercial | 300001 kWh | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | yes |

## Terms and desk timing

| Structure | Terms that may be priced | Quote validity | Pricing turnaround | Renewal priced through a new pricing request |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 12, 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days after the quote date | 2 business days | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 12, 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days | 2 business days | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 12, 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days | 2 business days | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 12, 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days | 2 business days | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 12, 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days | 2 business days | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 24 or 36 months | 3 calendar days | 2 business days | yes |

The pricing turnaround is the number of business days the structuring desk takes to price a request.

## Points of reading

- **Usage threshold:** a facility qualifies on usage when its 12-month historical usage is 300001 kWh or more; a facility at exactly 300000 kWh does not.
- **Renewable term:** a 12-month term cannot be priced on Fixed All-In Renewable; 24 and 36 months can.
- **Example (hypothetical):** a 36-month Block and Index request for a commercial facility in Ohio using 1.2 million kWh a year meets every threshold in these tables.
